title: 第15章 墨家传人第16章 宣誓主权
content_zh:
姜峰放下茶壶，神色沉凝：“昨夜抓回来的那个人，可审讯出什么？”
宋明远摇头叹了一口气：“没有，我从未见过骨头这么硬的人，无论用了什么手段，就是死扛着不说。”
醉仙楼的杀人案算是破了，但却引出了另一个更大的案子。
张员外，或者应该说，那个假的张员外，一直在跟另一伙人秘密做着某些违法之事。
“他的身份查出来了吗？”
姜峰问道。
宋明远知道姜峰话里的意思，昨日两人才推测过，对方很可能是军方的人。
宋明远摇头道：“江州城所有百夫长级别以上的人，都与此人不符。”
不良人府衙没有军方的档案记录，但有一个地方可以查到……不良人暗库！
那是将不良人暗探收集的情报，尽数汇聚于一处的秘密档案库，整个江州府衙只有苏烈统领有权调取暗库卷宗。
昨夜张府全家二十七口被杀，两名凶犯一死一伤，苏烈统领不得不调取军方的卷宗。
姜峰右手搭在桌面，拇指按捺不动，四指如波澜起伏，指尖敲打着桌面，发出一连串清脆的笃笃敲打声，神色陷入了沉思。
半晌后，他忽然开口道：“头儿，你还记得，昨晚萧大人将那人制服后，他说了什么吗？”
宋明远陷入了回忆：
“……我在黄泉路上等着你。”
他猛地抬起头，眼神带着一抹惊悚：“你的意思，他们的目标其实是萧大人？”
姜峰不置可否：“换个角度想，他的意思也可能是，如果萧大人想继续追查下去，那就一定会死。”
这时，他看向宋明远：“对了，头儿，你们在张府里面，找到真正的张员外吗？”
宋明远摇头道：“没有，他要么失踪，要么已经死了。”
姜峰点头道：“我更倾向于是失踪了。”

宋明远问道：“怎么说？”
经过昨天的两个案子，他对姜峰有了全新的认识，知道对方有着见微知着的能力。
“还记得昨天在醉仙楼发现杀人案后，我当时做出的推断吗？杀人凶手没有当场杀死张嚣，是为了从张嚣口中得知一个消息。
那么结合消失不见的张员外，所谓的消息已经呼之欲出了。”
姜峰说道。
宋明远顿时恍然：“对方想从张嚣得知的消息，就是真正的张员外在哪里？！”
姜峰继续推断道：“以此推断，那么对方灭掉张府二十七口人的原因，很可能就是为了隐藏张员外的下落，如果他们只想杀死张员外，根本不需要如此大费周章，连同张府其他人也一并灭杀。”
宋明远陷入沉思。
姜峰再次问道：“对了，那个假的张员外，身份可查出来了？”
宋明远点了点头：“此人名叫杨儒源，原来是张员外的伴读，后来做了张府的管家。”
所谓伴读，其实就是官宦世家，给后代子孙找来的陪读。
在景国，所谓的伴读，其实与书童不同。
书童是仆役，只负责主人的日常琐事。
而伴读，则表示这个人同样也是读书人，是主人家从小专门给自家孩子培养出来的左膀右臂。
因为是伴读，所以他最是熟悉张员外的一举一动，易容之后，可以真正的做到以假乱真，这也算是解答了为何一直无人识破假员外身份的原因……姜峰心中暗道。
那么，杨儒源冒充张员外的原因是什么？
他又是从什么时候开始，参与了那些见不得人的事情？
根据他昨夜听到两人的密谋，张员外之所以能成为市舶司的员外郎，也有幕后之人的功劳。
那么，杨儒源是从什么时候开始就在冒充张员外呢？
成为员外之前，还是成为员外之后？

这将是两个截然不同的真相。
content_en:
Jiang Feng put down the teapot and looked solemn: "What did the interrogation of the man captured last night reveal?"
Song Mingyuan shook his head and sighed: "No, I have never seen a person with such hard bones. No matter what means are used, he just carries it without saying anything."
The murder case in Zuixian Tower was solved, but it led to another bigger case.
Zhang Yuanwai, or should I say, the fake Zhang Yuanwai, has been secretly doing some illegal things with another group of people.
"Has his identity been found out?"
Jiang Feng asked.
Song Mingyuan knew the meaning of Jiang Feng's words. The two of them speculated yesterday that the other party was probably from the military.
Song Mingyuan shook his head and said: "All the people above the centurion level in Jiangzhou City are inconsistent with this person."
There are no military records in the Delinquent Mansion Office, but there is a place where you can find it...the Delinquent Secret Treasury!
It is a secret archive that collects all the information collected by bad spies in one place. Only Commander Su Lie in the entire Jiangzhou Prefecture has the right to access the secret archive files.
Last night, twenty-seven members of Zhang's family were killed. One of the two murderers was killed and the other injured. Commander Su Lie had to obtain military files.
Jiang Feng's right hand rested on the table, his thumb held still, his four fingers undulated like waves, his fingertips tapped the table, making a series of crisp tapping sounds, his expression was lost in thought.
After a while, he suddenly said: "Boss, do you still remember what Mr. Xiao said after he subdued the man last night?"
Song Mingyuan fell into memories:
"...I'll be waiting for you on Huangquan Road."
He raised his head suddenly, with a hint of horror in his eyes: "You mean, their target is actually Mr. Xiao?"
Jiang Feng was noncommittal: "If you think about it from another angle, he might also mean that if Mr. Xiao wants to continue the investigation, he will definitely die."
At this time, he looked at Song Mingyuan: "By the way, boss, have you found the real Zhang Yuanwai in the Zhang Mansion?"
Song Mingyuan shook his head and said: "No, he is either missing or dead."
Jiang Feng nodded and said, "I'm more likely to have disappeared."
Song Mingyuan asked: "How to say?"
After yesterday's two cases, he had a new understanding of Jiang Feng and knew that the other party had the ability to detect subtle things.
"Do you still remember the inference I made after the murder case was discovered in Zuixian Tower yesterday? The murderer did not kill Zhang Xiao on the spot because he wanted to get a piece of news from Zhang Xiao.
Then combined with the missing member Zhang, the so-called news is about to come out. "
Jiang Feng said.
Song Mingyuan suddenly realized: "The news that the other party wants to know from Zhang Xiao is where is the real Zhang Yuanwai?!"
Jiang Feng continued to deduce: "Based on this, the reason why the other party killed the twenty-seven members of the Zhang family was probably to hide the whereabouts of Zhang Yuanwai. If they just wanted to kill Zhang Yuanwai, there was no need to go to such great lengths to kill the rest of the Zhang family as well."
Song Mingyuan fell into deep thought.
Jiang Feng asked again: "By the way, has the identity of the fake Yuan Wai been found out?"
Song Mingyuan nodded: "This person's name is Yang Ruyuan. He was originally Zhang Yuanwai's companion, and later became the housekeeper of the Zhang family."
The so-called companions are actually the companions found by officials and noble families for their descendants.
In Jingguo, the so-called companion reading is actually different from the book boy.
The book boy is a servant and is only responsible for the daily chores of his master.
The companion reading means that this person is also a scholar, and is the right-hand man specially trained by the host for his children since childhood.
Because he was a companion reader, he was most familiar with Zhang Yuanwai's every move. After the disguise, he could truly distinguish the fake Yuan Wai from the real one. This also solved the reason why no one had ever figured out the identity of the fake Yuan Wai... Jiang Feng thought to himself.
So, what is the reason why Yang Ruyuan pretended to be Zhang Yuanwai?
When did he start participating in those shameful things?
According to him last nightAfter hearing the conspiracy between the two, the reason why Zhang Yuanwai became the Yuanwailang of the Shipping Department was also due to the contributions of the people behind the scenes.
So, when did Yang Ruyuan begin to impersonate Zhang Yuanwai?
Before becoming a member, or after becoming a member?
These would be two very different truths.
